shared_elements: bands of repeated small dot or bead patterning
necklace-like curved bands across chest area
justification: Both are stone works whose surfaces carry shallow incised relief of a headdressed human figure, with rows of small bead-like dots and curved band motifs across the chest, and a prominent disc/ring element. But A is a massive three-dimensional block-statue seen frontally with heavily weathered, schematic and abraded markings, while B is a flat rectangular slab with a crisply cut, naturalistic profile head and finely regularised curl and bead patterning — different formats, viewpoints and levels of finish.
